  The two-page CV. Its sibling cv-full.qmd carries the note on how both are
  assembled; the difference between them is entirely in the options below.

  This variant keeps only the entries flagged `in: [short]` in ../_cv.yml and prints
  one sentence of each (`show=summary`), preferring the `title-short:` / `place-short:`
  forms so a heading stays on one line. Publications are every article, working paper and
  report in ../_publications.yml, citations only — the whole list by type rather than the
  `selected: true` subset, which is now the home page's own selection. It carries no
  skills row; `in:` in ../_cv.yml is what says so.
-->
